subject: delta(client): WF move the read-only node observer and its read deadline into their own module so the node wallet session stays under the file size limit
note: createNodeObserver and the 10 s authority read deadline move unchanged into src/wallet/node-observer.mjs. The node-wallet entry re-exports createNodeObserver, so its public names do not change, and the session imports the deadline for its authority capability and TP-1 admission. node-wallet-session.mjs was at the 800-line limit before the qualification source was added beside admitTp1Authority; it is now under it. No core file changes, so HOLD.json is not re-pinned, and package.json is unchanged.
